game: Super Smash Bros. Melee NTSC 1.02 (GALE01, disc revision 2)
frameClock: Animation timeline frame encoded by synchronous and asynchronous timer commands. This records command timeline frames, not a claim about the first ordinary physics update tick.

decompile.license: No gameplay implementation license established in the inspected checkout.
decompile.scope: State and animation identifiers, command field layouts, and execution semantics used to interpret independently extracted retail numbers. No gameplay implementation copied or translated.

indexing.mapping: Motion state 236 selects submotion/animation ID 44; the Fighter_WaitAnimData table is indexed by anim_id. The command pointer and events below were read from entry 44, not entry 236.

physicsConnection: The common EscapeAir physics callback skips its normal velocity decay when cmd_vars[0] is nonzero and takes the ft_80084DB0 path instead. This establishes the authored event frame and branch condition; conversion to an ordinary physics update number is intentionally left to scheduler evidence.

verification.retailChecks: The animation entry is relocation-backed in each retail DAT. The independently recorded event frame, variable index and value were checked against the private command streams; no raw command words or command pointers are retained here.
verification.eventStreamTermination: The privately inspected stream terminates after its recorded state-variable event.
verification.externalBinaries: The ISO and extracted game files remain in private local storage and are not included in this repository.
